purpose: Define the operational objective as prospective data completeness with causal observation integrity, rather than treating every individual scheduler trigger as a research requirement.

problem_elimination_pass.final_goal: Continuously capture eligible prospective official E-layer disclosures without permanent observation gaps or causal timestamp falsification.
hard_constraints: Preserve genuine prospective collection and actual authoritative observation timestamps.
Preserve the active three-calendar-day AS_OF-2 through AS_OF scan window.
Preserve announcement_id deduplication and append-only observation semantics.
Preserve V2.8.4 classifier, triage, identity and effective-date rules.
Do not open outcome research, price/return research, fold3/fold4, Setup, First60, Episode, live execution or brokerage execution.
problem_elimination_pass.soft_constraint_removed: Every scheduled trigger must succeed for the research system to remain valid.
problem_elimination_pass.replacement: The scheduler is a trigger mechanism. Data coverage is the operational objective. A missed trigger is recoverable while every missed calendar date remains inside the next successful overlapping scan window; recovery must never backdate the actual observation time.

operational_model.scan_window_rule: AS_OF minus 2 calendar days through AS_OF inclusive

recovery_capacity.reason: A successful run on day D scans D-2, D-1 and D. Therefore one or two immediately preceding missed calendar days remain in scope; the earliest day after three consecutive misses does not.

2026_09_29_incident_interpretation.what_future_success_would_prove: A genuine later run successfully scans a window containing 2026-09-29 and processes observations using their actual later authoritative observation time, demonstrating recovery coverage rather than retroactively converting the missed trigger into a successful schedule event.

success_metrics.scheduler_reliability_metric: Whether genuine event=schedule runs occur under the active workflow.
success_metrics.data_coverage_metric: Whether each prospective calendar date remains covered by at least one successfully completed scan before it exits the overlapping window.
success_metrics.causal_integrity_metric: Recovered observations retain the actual observation/commit time and are never backdated.
success_metrics.dedup_integrity_metric: Repeated scanning of an already observed announcement produces no duplicate authoritative observation.
